import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering, KMeans
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, leaves_list, fcluster

fn='disease.samples.q1.tsv'
df=pd.read_csv(fn, sep='\\t', index_col=0)
print(df.shape)
print(df.columns.tolist())
X=np.log2(df+1)
# filter variable expressed genes
var=X.var(axis=1)
for n in [500,1000,2000,5000,10000]:
    top=X.loc[var.sort_values(ascending=False).head(n).index]
    M=top.T
    Z=StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True).fit_transform(M)
    p=PCA(n_components=4).fit_transform(Z)
    print('\\nN',n,'PCA')
    for s,coords in zip(df.columns,p):
        print(s, ['%.3f'%c for c in coords[:3]])
    print('explained', PCA(n_components=4).fit(Z).explained_variance_ratio_[:4])
    for k in [2,3,4]:
        km=KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=1, n_init=20).fit(Z)
        print('kmeans k',k, dict(zip(df.columns, km.labels_)))
    D=pdist(Z, metric='euclidean')
    L=linkage(D, method='ward')
    print('ward order', [df.columns[i] for i in leaves_list(L)])
    print('ward k2', dict(zip(df.columns, fcluster(L,2,criterion='maxclust'))))
    print('ward k3', dict(zip(df.columns, fcluster(L,3,criterion='maxclust'))))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
fn='disease.samples.q1.tsv'
df=pd.read_csv(fn, sep='\\t', index_col=0)
A=['Sample_2','Sample_3','Sample_5','Sample_7']
B=['Sample_1','Sample_4','Sample_6','Sample_8','Sample_9']
X=np.log2(df+1)
meanA=X[A].mean(axis=1); meanB=X[B].mean(axis=1)
lfc=meanA-meanB
# expression threshold and tstat
p=[]
for g,row in X.iterrows():
    try:
        p.append(ttest_ind(row[A], row[B], equal_var=False).pvalue)
    except Exception:
        p.append(np.nan)
res=pd.DataFrame({'meanA':meanA,'meanB':meanB,'lfc_A_vs_B':lfc,'p':p,'raw_meanA':df[A].mean(axis=1),'raw_meanB':df[B].mean(axis=1)})
res['abs']=res.lfc_A_vs_B.abs()
res=res[(res.raw_meanA+res.raw_meanB)>1]
print('Top A high (2,3,5,7):')
print(res.sort_values('lfc_A_vs_B', ascending=False).head(100).to_string())
print('\\nTop B high (1,4,6,8,9):')
print(res.sort_values('lfc_A_vs_B', ascending=True).head(100).to_string())
PY"
